veranderings.rede: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
The bare preposition 'in' at the end is colloquial; 'daarin' is the standard form and no longer.

veranderings.voor: brand in die enjin en die vuur
veranderings.na: brand in die enjin, en die vuur

veranderings.voor: kan net by die opening agter uit,
veranderings.na: kan net by die opening agter uitkom,
veranderings.rede: The verb is missing after 'kan'; 'agter uit' also reads like 'agteruit' (backwards), and 'uitkom' fixes both without adding a word.

veranderings.voor: Daardie stoot werk vorentoe en dryf
veranderings.rede: 'werk vorentoe' is wooden and repeats the 'vorentoe' that ends the sentence; the direction stays in 'dryf die hele vuurpyl vorentoe'.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
'aan 'n lyn langs' is not an idiomatic circumposition; 'langs 'n lyn' is natural and shorter.
AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences, each with its own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Wat laat die ballon verder beweeg?
veranderings.rede: 'iets ver kry' is colloquial; 'dryf' is the verb the lesson already uses for the push moving the rocket.

vlae.teks: Sy enjin brand daardie brandstof en agter aan hom is 'n groot opening. Heel bo sit die voertuig wat hy die ruimte in moet stuur.
vlae.rede: 'hom' could refer to the engine or to the rocket, and 'hy' in the next sentence switches back to the rocket; naming the noun would make it clear, but which one is meant is a content choice for the writer (and it lengthens the text).
